executive_summary: Harborview Commercial Bank N.A. proposes to extend a USD 12,000,000 senior secured term loan facility to Northwind Fabrication Ltd., supported by an unconditional parent guarantee from Northwind Holdings Inc. The facility features a 5.1-year tenor, quarterly principal amortization across 20 instalments, and interest set at Term SOFR plus 2.75% with a 0.50% floor. Loan proceeds will fund CNC machinery procurement and expansion of the Borrower's Plant 2 site in Dayton, Ohio. The credit profile is robust, with all 13 credit policy criteria fully satisfied. Collateral security provides healthy coverage with an initial loan-to-value ratio of 64.9% based on an independent appraisal of USD 18,500,000. Core covenants require a minimum 1.35x DSCR, maximum 3.0x leverage, and tangible net worth of at least USD 25,000,000. Primary issues involve missing definitions for critical covenant terms (EBITDA, Debt Service, and Financial Indebtedness) and long-term equipment depreciation. Recommendation is to approve with conditions, subject to finalizing legal definitions, verifying UCC perfection, and conditioning tranche drawdowns on documented machinery acquisition expenditures.

risk_register.title: Undefined Financial Covenant Metrics
risk_register.description: Clause 9 establishes financial covenants including a DSCR of 1.35x and a Total Debt to EBITDA leverage cap of 3.0x, but Section 2 provides no definitions for EBITDA, Total Debt, or Debt Service components, creating potential contractual disputes over calculation methodology.

evidence.quote: Debt Service Coverage Ratio: the Borrower shall maintain a DSCR of not less than 1.35x, tested quarterly on a rolling twelve-month basis.
Leverage: the ratio of Total Debt to EBITDA shall not exceed 3.0x.

risk_register.recommendation: Incorporate standard market definitions for EBITDA, Total Debt, and Debt Service in Section 2, accompanied by an agreed compliance certificate template.

risk_register.title: Machinery Collateral Depreciation and Realization Risk
risk_register.description: The USD 12,000,000 facility is secured solely by Plant 2 machinery and equipment appraised at USD 18,500,000. Industrial manufacturing machinery is prone to wear, technological obsolescence, and secondary market discounts upon liquidation, which may deteriorate the 64.9% LTV buffer over the 5-year term.

evidence.quote: The loan is secured by a first-priority security interest over all machinery and equipment located at Plant 2, 4100 Industrial Way, Dayton, Ohio.
An independent appraisal by Calder & Wynn Valuation Partners dated 15 January 2026 valued the collateral at USD 18,500,000.

risk_register.recommendation: Require periodic updated machinery valuations during the loan tenor and maintain mandatory ongoing inspection rights and active replacement-value insurance coverage.

risk_register.title: Tranche Drawdown and Capital Project Execution Risk
risk_register.description: Proceeds are designated for purchasing CNC machinery and expanding Plant 2, with drawdowns permitted in up to three tranches over 90 days. Supply chain delays, equipment delivery bottlenecks, or facility commissioning issues could impair scheduled operational ramp-up.

evidence.quote: Purpose: the Borrower shall apply all amounts borrowed towards the acquisition of CNC machinery and the expansion of its Plant 2 manufacturing facility.
Availability Period: the facility may be drawn in up to three tranches within 90 days of the Effective Date.

risk_register.recommendation: Tie subsequent tranche disbursements to verified proof of equipment purchase orders, invoices, and delivery milestones.

risk_register.title: Undefined Financial Indebtedness in Cross-Default Clause
risk_register.description: Clause 11.3 triggers an event of default if Financial Indebtedness exceeding USD 2,000,000 is accelerated, but 'Financial Indebtedness' is not defined, leaving ambiguity regarding whether capital leases, trade payables, or intercompany balances are included.

evidence.quote: Cross-default: any Financial Indebtedness of the Borrower exceeding USD 2,000,000 is declared due before its specified maturity.

risk_register.recommendation: Add a comprehensive definition of Financial Indebtedness in Section 2 to clearly delineate covered borrowing categories and carve out customary ordinary-course liabilities.

gaps: Definitions for key financial covenant terms including 'EBITDA', 'Total Debt', and 'Debt Service' are omitted from Section 2.
The term 'Financial Indebtedness' referenced in Clause 11.3 (Cross-default) is not defined in Section 2.
The form and specific line-item calculations for the quarterly compliance certificate referenced in Clause 10.2 are not attached or scheduled.

Specific collateral perfection mechanisms (such as UCC-1 filing requirements and landlord or mortgagee waivers for Plant 2 at 4100 Industrial Way) are not detailed under Conditions Precedent in Clause 12.1.
follow_up_actions: Amend Section 2 of the loan agreement to insert clear contractual definitions for 'EBITDA', 'Total Debt', 'Debt Service', and 'Financial Indebtedness'.
Attach an agreed standard quarterly Compliance Certificate template specifying the exact calculation formulas for all financial covenants.
Perform UCC lien searches and confirm first-priority security perfection over the machinery and equipment located at 4100 Industrial Way, Dayton, Ohio.
Condition second and third tranche disbursements within the 90-day availability period on receipt of verified capital expenditure invoices and equipment installation milestones.
Obtain and verify certificates of insurance demonstrating replacement-value equipment coverage and designating Harborview Commercial Bank N.A. as loss payee prior to first drawdown.
